Explain, with the help of a labelled diagram, the following three problems, viz., local maximum, plateau (shoulder), and ridge that can cause hill-climbing search to fail to reach the global optimum.
required_keywords: simple: first improving successor; steepest-ascent: best successor; stochastic: random improving; local maximum; plateau/shoulder; ridge
key_final_answer: Three variants differentiated; failures: local maximum, plateau/shoulder, ridge.

subject: AI
one_line_core_task: Explain how simulated annealing uses temperature and probability to escape a local maximum.
question_text: b) Assume a Hill Climbing algorithm has become trapped in a local maximum. Explain the algorithmic mechanics of how Simulated Annealing utilizes temperature and probability to escape this topological trap.
required_keywords: temperature T; delta V=Vnew-Vcurrent; P=exp(deltaV/T); example e^(-5/20)=0.779; cooling T(k+1)=alpha*T(k); geometric schedule
key_final_answer: Accept worse moves with probability exp(deltaV/T); cooling reduces acceptance.
